name: Translation Fix Suggestions
description: Drafts a corrected target-language line for each line a translation launch check flagged, checks every draft with copy_fit_check and redrafts up to twice. Keeps values, merge tags, links and formality; never adds claims.

parameters.name: fix_input
parameters.description: The lines to fix, copied exactly from the fix_input field of Score each language: one block per line with locale, line id, channel/field, Master, Translation, an optional Start from, Length and the Problems.

output.description: One suggested fix per flagged line, in input order, with whether copy_fit_check says it fits.
